details.description:
Extra red hot chilli flakes are intensely spicy crushed dried chilies with a vibrant crimson color and a heat level that goes beyond standard red pepper flakes. details.description: Snapin's Clove powder is an intensely aromatic ground spice made from dried flower buds of the clove tree, known for its powerful, warming flavor. Ground from whole dried cloves (Syzygium aromaticum), which are the unopened flower buds of an evergreen tree native to Indonesia. Extremely strong and penetrating—warm, sweet, and slightly bitter with a numbing, almost medicinal quality. Intensely fragrant and spicy-sweet, with an almost woody, resinous character. The smell is so potent it can dominate a spice cabinet if not properly sealed.Essential in gingerbread, pumpkin pie spice, chai masala, Indian biryani, mulled wine, ham glazes, and spice cookies. Also used in savory dishes like curries and stews, though always judiciously.

details.description: Anardana powder is a tangy, fruity spice made from dried and ground pomegranate seeds (arils). ntensely tangy and sour with a fruity sweetness underneath—like concentrated pomegranate with a punch.
